Name: Ghostytea's Cute Hats for Json Assets
Author: minervamaga
Description:
Ever get tired of the hats in SDV somedays?  Wished that your farmer had some cute bows or flower crowns?  How about a set of bunny ears for the Egg Festival?  Now, you can have the best of both worlds, with the brand new custom hats from Json Assets!

This mod requires [Json Assets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720)﻿ to work!

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4!

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Json Assets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720)﻿.

3.  Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  Run the game using SMAPI.
